Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id. Join compound_structures as an inner join on molregno. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1614455, standard_relation equals '=', and standard_value is not null. Do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
